clarifications_revision_chain_chk.name: clarifications_revision_chain_chk
clarifications_revision_chain_chk.value: "clarifications"."revision" > 0 AND (("clarifications"."revision" = 1 AND "clarifications"."previous_clarification_id" IS NULL) OR ("clarifications"."revision" > 1 AND "clarifications"."previous_clarification_id" IS NOT NULL))

clarifications_content_chk.name: clarifications_content_chk
clarifications_content_chk.value: char_length(btrim("clarifications"."question")) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND (("clarifications"."status" = 'open' AND "clarifications"."answer" IS NULL) OR ("clarifications"."status" IN ('answered', 'superseded') AND char_length(btrim("clarifications"."answer")) BETWEEN 1 AND 10000))

decisions_revision_chain_chk.name: decisions_revision_chain_chk
decisions_revision_chain_chk.value: "decisions"."revision" > 0 AND (("decisions"."revision" = 1 AND "decisions"."previous_decision_id" IS NULL) OR ("decisions"."revision" > 1 AND "decisions"."previous_decision_id" IS NOT NULL))

decisions_content_chk.name: decisions_content_chk
decisions_content_chk.value: char_length(btrim("decisions"."outcome")) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND char_length(btrim("decisions"."reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000

issues_revision_chain_chk.name: issues_revision_chain_chk
issues_revision_chain_chk.value: "issues"."revision" > 0 AND (("issues"."revision" = 1 AND "issues"."previous_issue_id" IS NULL) OR ("issues"."revision" > 1 AND "issues"."previous_issue_id" IS NOT NULL))

issues_identity_chk.name: issues_identity_chk
issues_identity_chk.value: char_length("issues"."issue_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "issues"."issue_key" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]*$' AND char_length(btrim("issues"."title")) BETWEEN 1 AND 300

repositories_identity_length_chk.name: repositories_identity_length_chk
repositories_identity_length_chk.value: char_length(btrim("repositories"."provider_repository_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND char_length(btrim("repositories"."owner")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND char_length(btrim("repositories"."name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200

spec_revisions_revision_chain_chk.name: spec_revisions_revision_chain_chk
spec_revisions_revision_chain_chk.value: "spec_revisions"."revision" > 0 AND (("spec_revisions"."revision" = 1 AND "spec_revisions"."previous_revision_id" IS NULL) OR ("spec_revisions"."revision" > 1 AND "spec_revisions"."previous_revision_id" IS NOT NULL))
